summary: Corner end of Townley Street, beside the park, with homes close beyond.
reasons: Houses 3 to 22 m along rest of line

best_section.where: East kerb just south of the Carmody Road junction, opposite the park

drivers.seclusion: Nearest homes 30 m at the junction end, but a house sits 7 m from 21 m along. Park opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars on both sides; room for a van at the kerb, close to the junction.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street off a busier cross road.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb in both images; 2P resident-permit signs apply on weekdays.

flags: Steep: about 5% grade in the first 10 m, up to 18% further on
Houses 3 to 22 m from the rest of the line
sun_shade: Open to the sky; trees at the corner shade the morning side.
